author: WantedDuck125
name: go_live
short: Manually announce Twitch streams with a role ping.
description: Provides a [p]go-live command that posts a Twitch announcement embed and pings a configured role, plus admin configuration commands.
install_msg: Configure with `[p]golive setrole @role` and `[p]golive setchannel #channel`. Optional: `[p]golive seturl https://twitch.tv/yourname`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server configuration only: role ID, channel ID, Twitch URL, embed title, and default announcement message. It does not store personal user data.
